Priya: Quick sync  we need a concise rollout for EU model-v2 that minimizes tenant blast radius. Proposal: header-driven QA slices (X-RW-Slice), then deterministic tenant cohorts (phase-1 = 12%), 6h shadow at 5%, then pct ramp. Need flag shape + rollback gates.
Omar: Agree header slices first. For cohorts use hashed tenant_id -> stable slices so we can repro. Add enterprise opt-out list.
Jen: Rollback gates: auto-rollback if error_rate >0.9% for 4m OR p95 >350ms over baseline for 10m OR rerank-delta >0.15 on sample set. On rollback: flip affected slices to compat-v1 and mark "quarantined".
Luca: Flag schema: `eu_v2` with fields `mode: header|cohort|pct`, `value`, `allowlist`, `shadow_pct`, `quarantine_ttl`. Console should show per-tenant variant.
Priya: Ops: can we add /health?variant=v2 probe that returns version + last_1m_p95? k8s readiness should use it. Also circuit: block auto-promote for 2h after region rollback.
CanaryBot: job-900900 queued: applying header routing and setting `eu_v2` mode=header value=12%. step-1 OK at 1740101035.
Jen: Action items: Priya write RFC with cohort list & thresholds (due EOD). Omar add header routing + health probe. Luca wire flag schema + console slice view. I'll implement rollback automation and audit events.
Priya: Sounds good  posting RFC shortly. :thumbsup:
